about.title: About Me
about.heroSubheading: React specialist with 10+ years building consumer-facing products and polished user experiences
about.profileSummary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 10+ years of experience building React applications, streaming platforms, and consumer-facing products. Passionate about UI quality, performance, and creating intuitive user experiences through close collaboration with product and design-minded stakeholders.
about.paragraph1: Senior Frontend Engineer specializing in React, TypeScript, and user-focused product development. I started coding in 2001 and have built my career around modern JavaScript ecosystems, with strong depth across component architecture, state management, responsive UI systems, performance, and maintainable frontend delivery.
about.paragraph2: After working as a Frontend Developer at InterCloud, I moved into entrepreneurship and am currently building two initiatives: Vue d'Esprit, a digital studio delivering web and product solutions, and Kaast, a media communication platform designed for internal company collaboration and engagement, already used by multiple clients.
about.paragraph3: My core strength is frontend execution, but I also bring solid full-stack experience when products require it. Across products such as Synqit, Soulbm, ASBA, and Kaast, I have worked on API design, backend systems, data modeling, and infrastructure alongside the frontend experiences, which helps me build interfaces that stay coherent within the broader product architecture.
about.hardSkillsIntro: Core frontend technologies, React ecosystem tools, and delivery capabilities I use to design, build, and ship polished product experiences at scale.
about.softSkillsIntro: How I collaborate, prioritize, and drive product delivery in real-world contexts.

synqit.title: Founder & Product Engineer
synqit.summary: Collaborative playlist platform for events and cross-service sharing between Spotify and Apple Music through a single magic link.
synqit.point1: Designed the full-stack architecture across host dashboards, guest flows, playlist moderation, and third-party music integrations.
synqit.point2: Defined the API structure and event data model for no-signup guest submissions, live moderation, event closing, and guest-link management.
synqit.point3: Built the frontend product experience in parallel with the backend logic that powers playlist import and cross-service sharing, with particular attention to onboarding flows, user retention, and reducing friction throughout the user journey.

kaast.title: Co-Founder & Lead Frontend Engineer
kaast.summary: Multi-tenant internal media communication platform used by multiple companies, with a strong focus on frontend product quality, navigation, search, and shared UI consistency across tenant-specific needs.
kaast.point1: Led the frontend structure of the React application, shaping page composition, navigation flows, and the overall product interaction model for a platform that had to adapt to each tenant's specific requirements.
kaast.point2: Built a maintainable UI foundation through shared components, SCSS and Tailwind styling layers, TanStack tooling, and integrated search experiences with Meilisearch, while still accommodating customer-specific variations.
kaast.point3: Worked in a two-person Kanban team, pushing customer-driven features within tight audit periods and collaborating closely with stakeholders and product discussions to translate requirements into intuitive user experiences while maintaining consistency across tenant-specific needs.

intercloud.title: Frontend Developer
intercloud.summary: Worked on a SaaS dashboard designed to support and automate low-level network deployment workflows, joining the project at proof-of-concept stage and helping push it toward a customer-facing MVP and V1 under tight delivery constraints.
intercloud.point1: Built and evolved dashboard interfaces in React for network deployment operations, turning complex technical workflows into clear, maintainable SaaS product experiences.
intercloud.point2: Contributed to the UI content system and shared component library, while shaping state and cache management with Redux Toolkit to keep the interface responsive and consistent.
intercloud.point3: Worked in a fast-paced agile environment to help move the product from proof of concept to MVP and then V1, using real-time server-sent events, search tooling including Elasticsearch and Meilisearch, and supporting Node-based tooling to keep operational data current across the product.
